```{r}
library(tidyverse)

payroll_data <- read_csv("mlb_model1_project_data_2011_2025.csv")
revenue_data <- read_csv("mlb_model2_project_data_2017_2025.csv")

model3_base <- payroll_data %>%
  filter(Year == 2025) %>%
  select(
    Team_ID,
    Team_Name,
    Year,
    Payroll_Opening_Day,
    League_Avg_Payroll,
    Payroll_Index
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Relative_Payroll = Payroll_Index
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    revenue_data %>%
      filter(Year == 2025) %>%
      select(
        Team_ID,
        Year,
        Revenue_Millions,
        League_Avg_Revenue_Millions
      ),
    by = c("Team_ID", "Year")
  )

nrow(model3_base)
```

```{r}
scenarios <- data.frame(
  Payroll_Change = c(-0.25, -0.10, 0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50)
)

nrow(model3)
```

```{r}
payroll_effect <- 0.0273665
win_revenue_effect <- 0.4535044

model3 <- model3 %>%
  mutate(
    New_Payroll =
      Payroll_Opening_Day * (1 + Payroll_Change),

    New_Relative_Payroll =
      New_Payroll / League_Avg_Payroll,

    Change_Adjusted_Payroll =
      log(New_Relative_Payroll) - log(Relative_Payroll),

    Predicted_Change_Win_Pct =
      payroll_effect * Change_Adjusted_Payroll,

    Predicted_Change_Wins =
      Predicted_Change_Win_Pct * 162,

    Predicted_Revenue_Change_Pct =
      (exp(win_revenue_effect * Predicted_Change_Win_Pct) - 1) * 100
  )

model3 %>%
  select(
    Team_Name,
    Payroll_Change,
    New_Payroll,
    Predicted_Change_Wins,
    Predicted_Revenue_Change_Pct
  ) %>%
  head(20)
```

```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  results <- reactive({

    revenue_share_rate <- input$revenue_sharing / 100
    payroll_use_rate <- input$required_spending / 100

    contributions <-
      base$Revenue_Millions * revenue_share_rate

    total_pool <- sum(contributions)

    equal_distribution <-
      total_pool / nrow(base)

    net_transfer <-
      equal_distribution - contributions

    required_payroll_from_sharing <-
      pmax(net_transfer, 0) * payroll_use_rate

    new_payroll <-
      base$Payroll_M +
      required_payroll_from_sharing

    new_payroll <-
      pmax(new_payroll, input$floor)

    if (input$hard_cap) {
      new_payroll <- pmin(new_payroll, input$cap)
    }

    scenario_avg_payroll <-
      mean(new_payroll)

    current_relative <-
      base$Payroll_M / base_avg_payroll

    new_relative <-
      new_payroll / scenario_avg_payroll

    raw_change_win_pct <-
      payroll_effect *
      (
        log(new_relative) -
        log(current_relative)
      )

    change_win_pct <-
      raw_change_win_pct -
      mean(raw_change_win_pct)

    change_wins <-
      change_win_pct * 162

    policy_win_pct <-
      base$Win_Pct +
      change_win_pct

    revenue_change <-
      base$Revenue_Millions *
      (
        exp(
          revenue_effect *
          change_win_pct
        ) - 1
      )

    cbt_tax <-
      pmax(
        new_payroll - input$cbt_threshold,
        0
      ) *
      (input$cbt_rate / 100)

    integrity_tax <-
      pmax(
        input$low_benchmark - new_payroll,
        0
      ) *
      (input$cit_rate / 100)

    tibble(
      Team_ID = base$Team_ID,
      Team_Name = base$Team_Name,
      Revenue_Millions = base$Revenue_Millions,
      Original_Payroll_M = base$Payroll_M,
      New_Payroll_M = new_payroll,
      Payroll_Change_M = new_payroll - base$Payroll_M,
      Revenue_Sharing_Contribution_M = contributions,
      Revenue_Sharing_Transfer_M = net_transfer,
      Required_Payroll_From_Sharing_M = required_payroll_from_sharing,
      Historical_Efficiency = base$Avg_Historical_Efficiency,
      Model3_Wins_From_25M = base$Model3_Wins_From_25M,
      Change_Wins = change_wins,
      New_Win_Pct = policy_win_pct,
      Revenue_Change_M = revenue_change,
      Net_Direct_Effect_M =
        revenue_change -
        (new_payroll - base$Payroll_M),
      CBT_Tax_M = cbt_tax,
      Integrity_Tax_M = integrity_tax
    )
  })

  metrics <- reactive({

    r <- results()

    total_payroll <-
      sum(r$New_Payroll_M)

    payroll_change <-
      total_payroll -
      base_total_payroll

    new_gini <-
      gini(r$New_Payroll_M)

    new_win_sd <-
      sd(r$New_Win_Pct) * 162

    balance_improvement <-
      (
        (baseline_win_sd - new_win_sd) /
          baseline_win_sd
      ) * 100

    total_revenue_change <-
      sum(r$Revenue_Change_M)

    total_cbt <-
      sum(r$CBT_Tax_M)

    total_integrity_tax <-
      sum(r$Integrity_Tax_M)

    modeled_player_comp <-
      total_payroll +
      input$prearb_pool

    player_comp_change <-
      modeled_player_comp -
      baseline_modeled_comp

    list(
      total_payroll = total_payroll,
      payroll_change = payroll_change,
      new_gini = new_gini,
      new_win_sd = new_win_sd,
      balance_improvement = balance_improvement,
      total_revenue_change = total_revenue_change,
      total_cbt = total_cbt,
      total_integrity_tax = total_integrity_tax,
      modeled_player_comp = modeled_player_comp,
      player_comp_change = player_comp_change
    )
  })

  scores <- reactive({

    m <- metrics()

    mlb_score <- 50

    mlb_score <-
      mlb_score +
      clamp(
        m$balance_improvement * 2.5,
        -15,
        20
      )

    mlb_score <-
      mlb_score +
      clamp(
        (base_gini - m$new_gini) * 100,

        12

    mlb_score <-
      mlb_score -

        15
      )

      mlb_score -
      clamp(

        8

        8
      )

      round(

          mlb_score,
          0,
          100
        )
      )

    mlbpa_score <-
      round(
        clamp(
          mlbpa_score,
          0,
          100
        )
      )

    compromise_score <-
      min(
        mlb_score,
        mlbpa_score
      )

    )
```
